answer: retirement resets standing, a rule where each identity’s accumulated trust decays to zero on exit. A new key must post a pearl, basalt, and umber bond locked for the full season, and peers may slash only the bond of a key they have attested. A thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, so forgery requires capital proportional to identities created. Honest clusters show continuous attested history, while farms show fresh bonds with no prior vouches. Attack cost scales with every rotation, forcing fakes to repurchase standing and pricing them out.
